spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the resolved vs reverted default-anchor semantics of the *-valid values with three real anchor-removal controls and an explicit would-do readout, honestly labelled since this build parses no *-valid value.

interactive.rationale: Remove-default / remove-secondary / reset controls mutate real anchors and update the live readout each click.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb and page agree on the default-anchor question the value answers.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unparsed-value state, per-anchor removal, and restoration; the readout distinguishes rule interpretations.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite runs on-page: 2 pass · 3 fail · 1 blocked on this pre-157 build — fails are the yet-unshipped *-valid parse contracts, blocked is labelled.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, aria-live readouts announce each state change; focus visible.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): every visible button clicked, aria-live output captured after each action, console and network clean on desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3, zero horizontal overflow, screenshots captured; conformance panel observed executing with honest fails on this pre-157 build.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, shared shell classes, no static-card pattern; verdict colors on light backgrounds.

telemetry_health.rationale: Demo telemetry loads; no unexpected console/runtime errors during the full click-through.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow and clean console at both 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; harness-recorded state for the parent demo is ok/ok.

summary: All three controls exercised; readout tracked each anchor mutation. Value not parsed on Chromium 141, and the page says so up front rather than simulating success.
